analysis.summaryJa: more・lessをnoやnotと組み合わせたときの話し手の感情と数量境界を整理する。no more thanは「わずか〜しか」、not more thanは中立的な「〜以下」、no less thanは驚きを伴う「〜も」。さらにnot ... any more/longer、know better than to、none the＋比較級を扱う。
grammarPoints: no more than＋数量で少なさを強調する
not more than＋数量で中立的な上限を示す
no less than＋数量で多さへの驚きを示す
not ... any more・any longerで以前の状態の終了を表す
know better than to doで分別があり行為を避けることを表す
none the＋比較級で少しも程度が変わらないことを表す
visualEvidence: NOの赤いレバーとNOTの青いレバーが強い感情と中立事実を対比する中央装置
no more than・not more than・no less thanを数量境界として並べた3段
not any more/longerの停止標識とknow betterの知恵のバッジ
none the wiserを「説明後も理解が増えない」と示す最下段
commonTraps: no more thanを単なる上限と解釈する
not more thanに話し手の「少なすぎる」という感情を読み込む
no less thanを「以下」と逆に解釈する
any moreを肯定文で「もう〜ない」の意味に使う
know better than toのto不定詞を目的行為と誤解する

questions.prompt: No more ------- eight people attended the optional briefing.
questions.translationJa: 任意参加の説明会にはわずか8人しか出席しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: no more than＋数量は、その数を少ないと捉える「〜しか」です。

questions.prompt: For safety reasons, the elevator may carry not more ------- twelve passengers.
questions.translationJa: 安全上、エレベーターに乗れるのは12人以下です。
questions.explanationJa: not more thanは感情を加えず上限を示します。

questions.prompt: The charity sale collected no less ------- $20,000 in one afternoon.
questions.translationJa: 慈善セールは午後だけで2万ドルもの金額を集めました。
questions.explanationJa: no less thanは数量の多さへの驚き・強調を表します。

questions.prompt: The branch does not accept paper applications any -------.
questions.translationJa: その支店ではもう紙の申込書を受け付けていません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... any moreは以前行っていたことの終了を表します。

questions.prompt: The damaged printer is not in service any -------.
questions.translationJa: 破損したプリンターはもう使用されていません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... any longerで状態が今は続いていないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Experienced agents know better than ------- disclose a customer’s password.
questions.translationJa: 経験豊富な担当者なら顧客のパスワードを明かすようなことはしません。
questions.explanationJa: know better than to doは分別があるのでその行為をしないという意味です。

questions.prompt: After reading the vague instructions twice, I was none the ------- informed.
questions.translationJa: 曖昧な説明を2回読んでも、私は少しも理解が深まりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: none the better informedは情報・理解が少しも改善しないことを表します。

questions.prompt: The introductory course lasts ------- three hours, so it covers only the basics.
questions.translationJa: 入門講座はわずか3時間しかないので、基礎だけを扱います。
questions.explanationJa: only the basicsが少なさの評価を支えるno more thanです。
questions.focus: 少なさを表すno more than

questions.prompt: Each parcel must weigh not ------- than 25 kilograms.
questions.translationJa: 各小包は25キロ以下でなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 規則上の上限はnot more thanで中立的に表します。

questions.prompt: The revised sign is larger, but it is none the ------- to read in poor light.
questions.translationJa: 改訂された看板は大きいですが、暗い所で読みやすさは少しも増していません。
questions.explanationJa: none the easierは予想に反して容易さが増していないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing disappointment at a small turnout.

choices.A: Not more five than suppliers attended the fair.
choices.B: No more than five suppliers attended the fair.
choices.C: No less five suppliers than attended the fair.
choices.D: No more five than suppliers attended the fair.

questions.translationJa: 見本市にはわずか5社の仕入先しか参加しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 少なさへの感情はno more thanで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence setting a neutral maximum.

choices.A: The repair will take no more two days than.
choices.B: The repair will take not most than two days.
choices.C: The repair will take no less than two days or fewer.
choices.D: The repair will take not more than two days.

questions.translationJa: 修理には2日以内しかかかりません。
questions.explanationJa: not more than two daysは「最大2日」という中立的な上限です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence emphasizing a surprisingly large number.

choices.A: No less than 600 customers downloaded the guide.
choices.B: No more than 600 customers downloaded it, which was surprisingly many.
choices.C: Not less 600 than customers downloaded the guide.
choices.D: No fewer 600 customers than downloaded the guide.

questions.translationJa: 600人もの顧客がガイドをダウンロードしました。
questions.explanationJa: no less than 600は600という多さを強調します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence saying a practice has ended.

choices.A: We do not any more issue printed receipts no.
choices.B: We issue not printed receipts any more do.
choices.C: We do not issue printed receipts any more.
choices.D: We do not issue printed receipts no longer.

questions.translationJa: 当社ではもう印刷した領収書を発行していません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... any moreが過去の習慣の終了を表します。no longerをnotと重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence saying a condition no longer continues.

choices.A: The old entrance is not accessible longer any.
choices.B: The old entrance is no accessible any longer.
choices.C: The old entrance is not accessible no longer.
choices.D: The old entrance is not accessible any longer.

questions.translationJa: 古い入口はもう利用できません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... any longerは状態の終了を表す正しい組合せです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about professional judgment.

choices.A: A trained accountant knows better to altering a signed invoice.
choices.B: A trained accountant knows better than to alter a signed invoice.
choices.C: A trained accountant knows best than alter a signed invoice.
choices.D: A trained accountant knows better than altering to a signed invoice.

questions.translationJa: 訓練を受けた会計担当者なら署名済み請求書を改変するようなことはしません。
questions.explanationJa: know better than to＋動詞原形が分別ある回避を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing no improvement in understanding.

choices.A: After the explanation, the visitors were none wiser.
choices.B: After the explanation, the visitors were not the wisest.
choices.C: After the explanation, the visitors were none the wiser.
choices.D: After the explanation, the visitors were no more wise than.

questions.translationJa: 説明後も来訪者は少しも理解が深まりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 定型のnone the wiserは理解が増えないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence contrasting effort with no benefit.

choices.A: The extra meeting left us none the closer to a decision.
choices.B: The extra meeting left us none closer to a decision.
choices.C: The extra meeting left us not the closest to a decision.
choices.D: The extra meeting left us no more close to a decision than.

questions.translationJa: 追加会議をしても、決定には少しも近づきませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: none the closer toで進展が全くないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving a neutral capacity limit.

choices.A: The room can hold no less than forty people at maximum.
choices.B: The room can hold not many than forty people.
choices.C: The room can hold no more forty people than.
choices.D: The room can hold not more than forty people.

questions.translationJa: その部屋の収容人数は40人以下です。
questions.explanationJa: 定員という中立的上限にはnot more thanが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence emphasizing abundance.

choices.A: The archive contains no more than two million records, surprisingly many.
choices.B: The archive contains not less two million than records.
choices.C: The archive contains no less than two million records.
choices.D: The archive contains no fewer two million records than.

questions.translationJa: 資料庫には200万件もの記録があります。
questions.explanationJa: no less thanは多さを強く印象づけます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "No more than nine employees joined the tour."

choices.A: At most nine employees were allowed to join, with no comment on the number.
choices.B: At least nine employees joined the tour.
choices.C: More than nine employees joined unexpectedly.
choices.D: Only nine employees joined the tour.

questions.translationJa: ツアーに参加した従業員はわずか9人だけでした。
questions.explanationJa: no more thanは話し手が少ないと感じるonlyに相当します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The package weighs not more than five kilograms."

choices.A: The package weighs exactly five kilograms.
choices.B: The package weighs five kilograms or less.
choices.C: The package is surprisingly light at five kilograms.
choices.D: The package must weigh at least five kilograms.

questions.translationJa: その荷物は5キロ以下です。
questions.explanationJa: not more thanは数量の上限を示し、or lessと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "No less than 300 guests attended."
questions.translationJa: 300人もの客が出席しました。
questions.explanationJa: no less thanは多さへの驚きをas many asで表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We do not use that courier any longer."

choices.A: We used that courier before, but we have stopped.
choices.B: We have never used that courier.
choices.C: We plan to use that courier for a longer time.
choices.D: We use the courier less frequently but still regularly.

questions.translationJa: 以前はその配送業者を使っていましたが、今はやめました。
questions.explanationJa: not ... any longerは以前の状態・習慣が今は終了したことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You should know better than to share the code."

choices.A: You should learn a better code to share.
choices.B: You should have enough judgment not to share the code.
choices.C: Sharing the code will improve your judgment.
choices.D: You should know who shared the code.

questions.translationJa: そのコードを共有しないだけの分別があるはずです。
questions.explanationJa: know better than to doは分別により行為を避ける意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I am none the wiser after reading the memo."

choices.A: The memo made me much wiser.
choices.B: I understood the memo better than anyone.
choices.C: I have not finished reading the memo.
choices.D: Reading the memo did not improve my understanding at all.

questions.translationJa: メモを読んでも理解は全く深まりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: none the wiserは理解の程度が少しも増えないことです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The delay made us none the less confident."

choices.A: The delay did not reduce our confidence at all.
choices.B: The delay completely removed our confidence.
choices.C: We became less confident because of the delay.
choices.D: We were confident only before the delay.

questions.translationJa: 遅延があっても私たちの自信は少しも減りませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: none the less confidentは予想される低下が全く起きないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The call lasted no more than a minute."

choices.A: The call could last up to a minute without any feeling of brevity.
choices.B: The call lasted at least one minute.
choices.C: The call lasted only one minute.
choices.D: The call lasted much longer than expected.

questions.translationJa: 電話はわずか1分しか続きませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: no more thanの話し手の少なさはonlyで表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Admission is not more than $15."

choices.A: The admission charge is at most $15.
choices.B: Admission is surprisingly cheap at exactly $15.

questions.translationJa: 入場料は最大15ドルです。
questions.explanationJa: not more thanはat mostという中立的上限です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The second test left the device none the worse."

choices.A: The device became worse during the test.
choices.B: The second test caused no additional damage to the device.
choices.C: The device was already the worst one.
choices.D: The test repaired all earlier damage.

questions.translationJa: 2回目の試験で装置に追加の損傷は生じませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: none the worseは悪化が少しもなかったことを表します。

questions.prompt: The optional webinar was advertised to the whole company, but ------- twenty employees attended. The organizer was disappointed.
questions.translationJa: 任意参加のウェビナーは全社に告知されましたが、わずか20人しか出席せず、主催者は落胆しました。
questions.explanationJa: disappointedが少なさへの感情を示すためno more thanです。

questions.prompt: The cabinet has a strict weight limit. Each shelf may support ------- 30 kilograms.
questions.translationJa: キャビネットには厳格な重量制限があります。各棚が支えられるのは30キロ以下です。
questions.explanationJa: 規則上の中立的な最大値はnot more thanです。

questions.prompt: The video attracted unexpected attention. It received ------- one million views in a week.
questions.translationJa: その動画は予想外の注目を集め、1週間で100万回もの再生を記録しました。
questions.explanationJa: unexpected attentionが多さへの驚きを支えるno less thanです。

questions.prompt: Our branch switched to digital invoices in June. We do not mail paper copies any -------.
questions.translationJa: 当支店は6月に電子請求書へ移行しました。もう紙の控えは郵送していません。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の習慣の終了をnot ... any moreで表します。

questions.prompt: The lease ended last month. The company does not occupy the second floor any -------.
questions.translationJa: 賃貸契約は先月終了しました。会社はもう2階を使用していません。
questions.explanationJa: 状態の終了にはnot ... any longerが適切です。

questions.prompt: The privacy policy is covered in every training session. Staff members should know better than ------- customer files unattended.
questions.translationJa: 個人情報方針は毎回の研修で扱われます。職員なら顧客ファイルを放置するようなことはしないはずです。
questions.explanationJa: know better than to＋動詞原形で分別による回避を表します。

questions.prompt: The technician used several technical terms without defining them. After the explanation, the customer was none the -------.
questions.translationJa: 技術者は専門用語を定義せずに使いました。説明後も顧客は少しも理解が深まりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 理解が増えなかった文脈なのでnone the wiserです。

questions.prompt: We held two extra meetings, but no option gained enough votes. We are none the ------- to a final decision.
questions.translationJa: 追加会議を2回開きましたが、十分な票を得た案はありません。最終決定には少しも近づいていません。
questions.explanationJa: 進展がないことをnone the closer toで表します。

questions.prompt: The tiny booth had a surprisingly rich display. It contained ------- eighty product samples.
questions.translationJa: 小さなブースには驚くほど充実した展示があり、80点もの製品見本がありました。
questions.explanationJa: surprisingly richが多さの強調no less thanを要求します。

questions.prompt: The new label is brighter, but the letters are still too small. The instructions are none the ------- to read.
questions.translationJa: 新しいラベルは明るくなりましたが、文字はまだ小さすぎます。説明は少しも読みやすくなっていません。
questions.explanationJa: 改善があっても読みやすさが増していないためnone the easierです。
